lane: Sol medium diagnosis and acceptance repair
observation: The exact candidate's fresh guest run reached a page-text tool state. The old runner saw two Copy reply matches and no Stop button, but the screenshot contained only Reasoning and Finding text. It did not observe the final answer, guest reload, or follow-up.
confirmed_cause: The acceptance predicate treated one finalized assistant bubble as completion of the whole turn. A delegated client tool intentionally ends its current stream and resumes after tool_results; ChatView can render Copy reply and no Stop button in that gap.
product_verdict: unverified: the old capture cannot distinguish eventual success from a failed tool resume or terminal wrong answer
repair: The runner now records only safe run ordinals, event names, allowlisted error codes, status codes, completion outcomes, and text-chunk counts from panel stream broadcasts. It waits for terminal stream completion, reads the assistant's rendered Markdown text without reasoning/tool rows, and classifies terminal wrong, empty, error, and correct answers separately. Failed user-request completion takes priority over end reason complete; an uncoded resume 409 remains pending. The opening and post-reload turns use the same oracle.

validation.focused_tests: Initial five cases passed. Collector-seam tests for failed completion, successful completion, and multi-tool uncoded 409 were added after peer review; execution awaits guarded test admission.
validation.syntax: node --check passed for runner, oracle, and test file after round-one repair
validation.independent_review: first source review found important gaps; fresh review of round-one repair pending

limitations: The prior panel CDP network watcher is attached to the side panel, while fetch runs in offscreen; empty guest_ai_requests is not evidence that no request was sent.
The new trace has not yet been exercised on an owned Chrome profile and must be independently reviewed before interpreting a new candidate result.

The stream adapter exposes only resume_conflict as a named 409; an uncoded 409 cannot prove whether a request is permanently not resumable. The oracle leaves it pending and reports terminal_not_observed if no later continuation arrives.
No product code was changed and no 0.2.173 acceptance pass is claimed.
